spec.description: NAS host, storage maintenance, disks and backups. Select central Kube Prometheus when importing. Missing readings are not treated as healthy. Filesystem space is per mount, not summed ZFS pool allocation; snapshots, reservations and shared pool space can affect these readings.

spec.title: Container state
spec.description: Running is separate from healthy. Missing readings are unknown, not healthy.

spec.title: Container health checks
spec.description: Podman's configured health checks. Unknown can mean no health check is configured.

spec.title: App CPU
spec.description: 100% is one CPU core. An app can use more than one core.

spec.title: Podman exporter scrape health
spec.description: One exporter per rootless account. UP means metrics can be read, not that the app is healthy. Ports: 9882 Jellyfin, 9883 Prometheus, 9884 WebDAV.
Current failed health or threshold checks, not historical warnings. Check collector status and observation age alongside this panel.
spec.title: SMART health

spec.description: Linux block-device names. Includes all exported block devices; do not sum layered devices to estimate physical throughput.
spec.title: Disk throughput

spec.description: Unknown history is shown separately, not as a successful scrub. Orange at 35 days; red at the central alert's 38-day deadline.
spec.title: Time since successful full scrub

spec.description: A zero failed flag alone does not prove a successful scrub. Check the successful full scrub age too.
spec.title: Last full scrub result

spec.description: Completed Restic backups. Four hours is the existing share-backup alert deadline. Missing sources do not produce bars; check the backup journal for the full configured source list.
spec.title: Time since off-site backup

spec.description: Central scrape health. DOWN includes disappearance from discovery, using the independent expected-host recording rule.
spec.title: Node exporter

spec.description: Separate encrypted server-backup replication. Dry runs deliberately do not publish completion. Missing data can mean no approved live sync has completed.
spec.title: Time since server-backup cloud sync

spec.description: Collector success is separate from disk/pool health. Missing expected disks and pools also raise central alerts.
spec.title: Collector status

spec.description: Red after 15 minutes without a fresh successful observation. Read health panels together with this panel.
spec.title: Age of latest observation

spec.description: Actual zpool allocation, not the sum of dataset mount usage. Includes allocation that cannot be inferred from filesystem free space.
spec.title: Pool allocated

spec.description: Raw pool free bytes. Dataset-available space may be lower due to redundancy, reservations, quotas and ZFS overhead.
spec.title: Pool free

spec.description: ZFS free-space fragmentation. Unsupported readings are omitted, not reported as zero.
spec.title: Pool fragmentation

spec.description: ZFS used property, including descendants and snapshots. Parent/child values overlap: do not add them together.
spec.title: Dataset space used

spec.description: ZFS usedbysnapshots for each dataset. This is space accounting, not evidence that snapshots are recent or restorable.
spec.title: Space used by snapshots

spec.description: ONLINE means the pool was verified online at the last successful observation. Check telemetry age below; stale readings are not proof of current health.
spec.title: Pool health

spec.expr: ALERTS{alertstate="firing",netbox_device_name="$host"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing",alertname=~"Share Backup Missing|Share Cleanup Missing|Server Offsite Backup Not Running"}

spec.description: Host-labelled alerts and existing share-backup alerts. Backup rules do not currently retain a host label; those alerts are shown unfiltered by host.
spec.title: Firing alerts

spec.description: Uses MemAvailable so reclaimable cache is not counted as unavailable memory.
spec.title: Memory

spec.description: Per-mounted-filesystem usage, including the boot filesystem and ZFS datasets. Do not sum ZFS datasets: they share pool space. This is not zpool allocation or snapshot accounting.
spec.title: Filesystem usage
